# The first mutation run fails with a lived mutant. Candidate 1 gets no full review: the fix lane of candidate 2 gets the finding first.
# The fixed head gets a scoped review, a clean mutation run, then its full review.
exec beehest run 7 --workflow flow/workflow.star
stdout 'item 7 finished'

exec beehest status
stdout '^item-7-r1\tdone\tgate pass at [0-9a-f]+\treview 3/24\t'

# The job runs on the build host in the slot class, with the base ref of the round as its last word.
grep -count=2 '^build mutation sh mutation.sh origin/integration$' mutation.log

# The first fix takes the hit of the implementer and is clean, so the lived mutant is the first finding of the second fix.
# The fixes inside candidate 1 and the fixes after it are both fix round 1.
grep -count=1 '^implement ' calls.log
grep -count=2 '^fix 1 ' calls.log
! grep '^fix 2 ' calls.log
grep -count=3 '^review ' calls.log
grep -count=1 '^found=The mutation run failed. Each line is one finding:$' findings.log
grep -count=1 '^- internal/a.go:12: a mutant lived: CONDITIONALS_NEGATION$' findings.log
! grep 'KILLED' findings.log

cmp events.log expected-events.log

-- mutations --
sh mutation.sh origin/integration => lived
sh mutation.sh origin/integration => clean
-- verdicts --
approve
approve
approve
-- expected-events.log --
claim 7
release 7
